column1: # Normalised band profiles, measured with ../analysis/profile.sh FILE 0 on the
# files in this directory, 2026-10-20. Each band is that band's mean level
# relative to the file's own overall mean, so two files can be compared without
# matching their loudness first. Reading them as absolute levels is the mistake
# that cost two rounds of work; see ../BRIEF.md, correction 6.
# Not shipped as files, both one minute of seed 7 at 192 kbps, measured the
# same way: what the mallets cost. They bypass the master slope by design, and
# they are the whole of the generated piece's excess above 2 kHz.
